examples.japanese: ソファに{座|すわ}ってテレビを{見|み}た。
examples.english: I sat on the sofa and watched TV.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいソファは{座|すわ}り{心地|ごこち}がいい。
examples.english: The new sofa is comfortable to sit on.

examples.japanese: {革|かわ}のソファは{手入|てい}れが{大変|たいへん}だ。
examples.english: Leather sofas require a lot of maintenance.

notes:
ソファ (from English "sofa") is a common loanword for a Western-style couch or sofa. Also written as ソファー with a long vowel.

Common types:
- {二人掛|ふたりが}けソファ (two-seater sofa)
- {三人掛|さんにんが}けソファ (three-seater sofa)
- カウチソファ (sectional sofa with chaise)
- ソファベッド (sofa bed)

Common expressions:
- ソファに{横|よこ}になる (lie down on the sofa)
- ソファでくつろぐ (relax on the sofa)
